title: Hanuman Took the Mountain Back
status: DRAFT v2 (part 1 of 2) — CE Yuddha 6.61 read; review before posting
source: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda 6.61 (Critical Edition; vulgate 6.74)

claims.claim: Indrajit's Brahmastra struck down Rama and Lakshmana
Sixty-seven crore monkeys were struck down
At night Hanuman and Vibhishana searched the field with torches
Jambavan, aged and covered with arrows, could not see and knew Vibhishana by his voice
Jambavan asked whether Hanuman still lived
claims.quote_sa: अञ्जना सुप्रजा येन मातरिश्वा च नैरृत । हनूमान् वानरश्रेष्ठः प्राणान्धारयते क्व चित् ॥

claims.claim: Vibhishana asked why he asked of Hanuman and not the princes
While Hanuman lives the beaten army is unbeaten; if he dies we are dead though alive
claims.quote_sa: तस्मिञ्जीवति वीरे तु हतमप्यहतं बलम् । हनूमत्युज्झितप्राणे जीवन्तो ऽपि वयं हताः ॥

claims.claim: Jambavan sent him to the Himalaya, to the herb mountain between Rishabha and Kailasa, with four herbs
The herbs, knowing a seeker was coming, hid
claims.quote_sa: महौषध्यस्तु ताः सर्वास्तस्मिन्पर्वतसत्तमे । विज्ञायार्थिनमायान्तं ततो जग्मुरदर्शनम् ॥

claims.claim: Hanuman reproached the mountain for showing no compassion to Raghava and threatened it with the might of his arms
claims.quote_sa: किमेतदेवं सुविनिश्चितं ते यद् राघवे नासि कृतानुकम्पः ।

claims.claim: On the sun's path he shone like a rival sun
The herbs' fragrance alone freed both princes of their arrows; the monkey heroes rose
claims.quote_sa: तावप्युभौ मानुषराजपुत्रौ तं गन्धमाघ्राय महौषधीनाम् । बभूवतुस्तत्र तदा विशल्याव् उत्तस्थुरन्ये च हरिप्रवीराः ॥

claims.claim: He carried the herb mountain back to the Himalaya and rejoined Rama
claims.quote_sa: ततो हरिर्गन्धवहात्मजस्तु तमोषधीशैलमुदग्रवीर्यः । निनाय वेगाद्धिमवन्तमेव पुनश्च रामेण समाजगाम ॥

claims.claim: There is a second herb-mountain trip later, for Lakshmana

shots.hi: क्या हनुमान जी, संजीवनी का पर्वत, सिर्फ़ एक बार लाए थे?
shots.en: Did Hanuman bring the herb mountain only once?
units: [thoughtfully] क्या हनुमान जी… संजीवनी का पर्वत, सिर्फ़ एक बार लाए थे?

shots.hi: वाल्मीकि रामायण, युद्ध कांड, सर्ग इकसठ। ततो हरिर्गन्धवहात्मजस्तु तमोषधीशैलमुदग्रवीर्यः । निनाय वेगाद्धिमवन्तमेव पुनश्च रामेण समाजगाम ॥ ये है असली कहानी।
units: वाल्मीकि रामायण, युद्ध कांड, सर्ग इकसठ।
[with deep devotion] [chanting] ततो हरिर्गन्धवहात्मजस्तु तमोषधीशैलमुदग्रवीर्यः… निनाय वेगाद्धिमवन्तमेव पुनश्च रामेण समाजगाम॥
[serious] ये है असली कहानी।

sloka.en: “Then the mighty son of the wind swiftly carried that herb mountain back to the Himalaya, and rejoined Rama.”
sloka.translit: tato harirgandhavahātmajastu tamoṣadhīśailamudagravīryaḥ, nināya vegāddhimavantameva punaśca rāmeṇa samājagāma

shots.sloka_pick: take 1 [reverently] [slowly]: most pitch movement (4.64 st), words intact, p95 160 Hz (take 3 equal movement but peaks 195 Hz, over the shouting guard)

shots.hi: पर वाल्मीकि में, पर्वत आता है दो बार। और पहली बार, लक्ष्मण अकेले नहीं गिरे थे।
shots.en: But in Valmiki, the mountain comes twice. And the first time, Lakshmana wasn't the only one who fell.
units: [serious] पर वाल्मीकि में, पर्वत आता है दो बार।
[thoughtfully] और पहली बार, लक्ष्मण अकेले नहीं गिरे थे।

shots.hi: इंद्रजीत के ब्रह्मास्त्र से, राम और लक्ष्मण दोनों गिरे। और साथ में, सड़सठ करोड़ वानर।
shots.en: Indrajit's Brahmastra felled both Rama and Lakshmana. And sixty-seven crore vanaras with them.
units: [serious] इंद्रजीत के ब्रह्मास्त्र से, राम और लक्ष्मण दोनों गिरे।
और साथ में, सड़सठ करोड़ वानर।

shots.hi: रात में, मशाल लिए, हनुमान और विभीषण खोजते हैं। बाणों से बिंधे बूढ़े जाम्बवान, जिन्हें कुछ दिखता नहीं।
shots.en: At night, with torches, Hanuman and Vibhishana search. Old Jambavan lies pierced by arrows, unable to see.
units: [softly] रात में, मशाल लिए, हनुमान और विभीषण खोजते हैं।
बाणों से बिंधे बूढ़े जाम्बवान… जिन्हें कुछ दिखता नहीं।

shots.hi: क्या वानरश्रेष्ठ हनुमान, कहीं जीवित है?
shots.en: "Does Hanuman, the best of the vanaras, still live?"
units: क्या वानरश्रेष्ठ हनुमान… कहीं जीवित है?

shots.hi: विभीषण चकित हैं। राजकुमारों से पहले, हनुमान क्यों?
shots.en: Vibhishana is puzzled. Why Hanuman, before the princes?
units: [thoughtfully] विभीषण चकित हैं। राजकुमारों से पहले, हनुमान क्यों?

shots.hi: जब तक वो वीर जीवित है, हारी हुई सेना भी हारी नहीं। पर हनुमान न रहे, तो हम जीवित होकर भी मरे हुए हैं।
shots.en: "While that hero lives, even a beaten army is unbeaten. If Hanuman is gone, we are dead, though alive."
units: जब तक वो वीर जीवित है… हारी हुई सेना भी, हारी नहीं।
पर हनुमान न रहे… तो हम जीवित होकर भी, मरे हुए हैं।

shots.hi: हनुमान उनके चरण छूते हैं। और जाम्बवान भेजते हैं हिमालय, ऋषभ और कैलाश के बीच, औषधियों का पर्वत।
shots.en: Hanuman touches his feet. Jambavan sends him to the Himalaya: the herb mountain, between Rishabha and Kailasa.
units: [warmly] हनुमान उनके चरण छूते हैं।
और जाम्बवान भेजते हैं हिमालय… ऋषभ और कैलाश के बीच, औषधियों का पर्वत।

shots.hi: पर वहाँ, औषधियाँ, किसी को आता जानकर, छिप गईं।
shots.en: But there, the herbs sensed a seeker coming, and hid.
units: [curious] पर वहाँ, औषधियाँ… किसी को आता जानकर, छिप गईं।

shots.hi: क्या तुमने यही तय किया है, कि प्रभु श्रीराम पर तुम्हें दया नहीं? तो अब देखो, मेरी भुजाओं का बल।
shots.en: "Is this your decision, then, to show no compassion to Lord Rama? Then see the strength of my arms."
units: क्या तुमने यही तय किया है… कि प्रभु श्रीराम पर, तुम्हें दया नहीं?
तो अब देखो… मेरी भुजाओं का बल।

shots.hi: और पूरा शिखर उखाड़ लिया। सूर्य के मार्ग पर, जैसे सूर्य के पास, दूसरा सूर्य।
shots.en: He tore off the whole peak. On the sun's path, like a second sun beside the sun.
units: [serious] और पूरा शिखर उखाड़ लिया।
सूर्य के मार्ग पर… जैसे सूर्य के पास, दूसरा सूर्य।

shots.hi: वाल्मीकि कहते हैं: तावप्युभौ मानुषराजपुत्रौ, तं गन्धमाघ्राय महौषधीनाम्। यानी, सुगंध भर से, दोनों राजकुमार बाणों से मुक्त हो गए, और वानर वीर उठ खड़े हुए।
units: [thoughtfully] वाल्मीकि कहते हैं:
[softly] तावप्युभौ मानुषराजपुत्रौ… तं गन्धमाघ्राय महौषधीनाम्।
यानी, सुगंध भर से, दोनों राजकुमार बाणों से मुक्त हो गए… और वानर वीर उठ खड़े हुए।

lines: बभूवतुस्तत्र तदा विशल्याव् उत्तस्थुरन्ये च हरिप्रवीराः ॥
quote.translit: tāvapyubhau mānuṣarājaputrau taṃ gandhamāghrāya mahauṣadhīnām, babhūvatustatra tadā viśalyāv uttasthuranye ca haripravīrāḥ
quote.en: “Just by smelling the fragrance of the great herbs, both princes were freed of their arrows; and the other vanara heroes rose.”

shots.hi: फिर हनुमान, पर्वत को वापस हिमालय पर छोड़ आए, और राम के पास लौट आए।
units: [warmly] फिर हनुमान, पर्वत को वापस हिमालय पर छोड़ आए… और राम के पास लौट आए।

shots.hi: ये थी पहली यात्रा। दूसरी बार पर्वत आया, लक्ष्मण के लिए। वो कथा, अगले भाग में।
shots.en: That was the first trip. The second time, the mountain came for Lakshmana. That story, in part 2.
units: [serious] ये थी पहली यात्रा।
[thoughtfully] दूसरी बार पर्वत आया, लक्ष्मण के लिए… वो कथा, अगले भाग में।

shots.hi: ऐसी और अनसुनी कहानियों के लिए, फ़ॉलो करें।
units: [warmly] ऐसी और अनसुनी कहानियों के लिए, फ़ॉलो करें।

thumbnail.line: The herb mountain, the first time.

score.prompt: Devotional-heroic Indian film underscore, instrumental only, built to sit under a spoken voice. Opens with a soft tanpura drone and a low bansuri phrase over a night battlefield hush; slow frame drums enter as a search by torchlight; around one third through, a rising heroic build with dhol, low brass and strings as the hero leaps into the sky, and one huge bright impact hit with choir pads as a mountain is lifted toward the sun; then it settles into a warm, quiet passage; a second, smaller build in the last third; it ends in a calm, glowing, devotional resolution. Sparse mid-range, no vocals, no lead melody fighting the narration, crisp modern film production.
score.take: take 2 of 2: quiet first 20 s under the śloka and Chalisa quote, build at 20 s, peak ~55 s (the peak lifted)

avoid: any disrespect to the Hanuman Chalisa or Goswami Tulsidas: both are told with devotion; we only add what Valmiki tells
saying the Chalisa or Manas is 'wrong': the Chalisa line is about the Lakshmana trip, which Valmiki also has
gore: the 67-crore fallen army shown as still silhouettes, no blood
saying the Chalisa is wrong: part 1 does not name it; the Lakshmana trip (part 2, A101) is the one the Chalisa sings
verify_note: CE 6.61.1-4,12: Indrajit's Brahmastra fells Rama, Lakshmana and 67 crore monkeys. 6.61.7,13-17: Hanuman and Vibhishana search with torches at night; old Jambavan, covered in arrows, can't see, knows Vibhishana by voice. 6.61.18: asks if Hanuman lives. 6.61.19-20: Vibhishana asks why Hanuman before the princes. 6.61.21-22: 'while he lives the beaten army is unbeaten; if he dies we are dead though alive'. 6.61.24: Hanuman clasps his feet. 6.61.29-34: Himalaya, between Rishabha and Kailasa, four herbs. 6.61.58: the herbs hide. 6.61.59-61: angry speech to the mountain, uproots the peak. 6.61.63: like a rival sun on the sun's path. 6.61.67: the fragrance frees both princes of arrows; monkey heroes rise. 6.61.68: he carries the mountain back to the Himalaya and rejoins Rama. 6.88.30-35: Ravana hurls the Maya-made shakti; it strikes Lakshmana's chest. 6.89.9-16: Sushena: not dead; sends Hanuman to the mountain 'described before by Jambavan'. 6.89.17-21: he doesn't know the herbs, brings the peak. 6.89.22-24: Sushena crushes the herb, gives it through the nose; Lakshmana rises. Hanuman Chalisa ch. 11 (ramcharit.in). Ramcharitmanas Lanka Kand: Meghnad's shakti (before doha 54), 'देखा सैल न औषध चीन्हा। सहसा कपि उपारि गिरि लीन्हा॥' (after doha 56).
caption: Most of us know one herb-mountain trip: for Lakshmana. But in Valmiki's Ramayana, Hanuman makes an earlier one. Indrajit's Brahmastra had felled BOTH Rama and Lakshmana and much of the army. At night, old Jambavan, blinded by arrows, asks first: "Is Hanuman alive?" because while Hanuman lives, the army is not beaten. On the Himalaya the herbs hide from Hanuman, so he lifts the whole peak and flies on the sun's path like a second sun. The fragrance alone heals everyone, and then he carries the mountain back to the Himalaya. Part 2: the trip we all know.
